newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: A'dam options trade suspended due to heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: A'dam options trade suspended due to heavy selling.

text.p: Trade was suspended on the Amsterdam options exchange on Thursday afternoon due to heavy selling, a spokeswoman of the exchange said.
The spokeswoman was unable to give further details immediately.
Amsterdam's AEX stock market index has fallen over 70 points in the last seven sessions since hitting an all-time high of 779.02 on March 11.
A few minutes before the close of trading on Thursday the AEX index was off 29.38 points or 4.0 percent at 705.66.
"There was such a big wave of selling that it was advisable to suspend trade," Dutch news agency ANP quoted an exchange spokesman as saying.
ANP said the stock exchange had also suspended trading in "baskets" of the 25 blue-chip shares which make up the AEX index.
